title: Source activity 1: Decimal place value
instruction: Digits after the decimal represent tenths, hundredths, thousandths, etc.

title: Source activity 2: Division by powers of ten
instruction: Dividing by 10,100,1000 shifts the decimal left by the number of zeroes.

title: Source activity 3: Decimal multiplication
instruction: Multiply as integers/fractions and place the decimal using total decimal digits.

title: Source activity 4: Products below one
instruction: A product need not be larger than both factors.
